name: Prism Core-Wasm guest contract hologram:guest/core-wasm@1
statement: The Core-Wasm guest contract: an import-free wasm32 core module exporting exactly memory, holo_alloc (i32 to i32) and holo_run (i32, i32 to i64), run on a fresh instance per request; the ABI of every Verdant Prism generator guest (REQ-PRISM-GENERATION).
